See Bible Dictionary, “Judges, book of.” Two final episodes recorded inJudges 17–21highlight Israel’s lack of unity in this era and may be implying the need for a king. The final verse of Judges states, “In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes” (Judges 21:25).

SeeExodus 20:1–6, 22–23. InDeuteronomy 6:3–15, the Israelites were again commanded to love the one true God with all their hearts. In both instances, Jehovah stated He is a “jealous” God. Unlike the Canaanites’ false gods, Jehovah requires singular devotion from His covenant people. See also “Exodus 20:4–5; 34:14. Why does the Lord refer to Himself as a ‘jealous God’?”
